headline: Stocks Start the Day Lower: BIST 100 Falls Below 12,500 Points | Economy
summary: The BIST 100 index opened at 12,516 points, down 0.61% from the previous close. Banking stocks rose slightly while holding and leasing-factoring shares declined.
why: BIST 100 is the benchmark index of the largest companies listed on Borsa Istanbul, reflecting the broad direction of Turkish equities.
